parts.name: Mini Scales native inner carrier and button
Mini Scales stainless U load cell
Mini Scales load-cell bonded strain cover

notes: The native assembly is components 0/3/4. Component 4 is the welded union of the separately laid-out carrier (5) and load cell (6); reconstruct these two in their exact assembly coordinates so stainless steel and the strain cover receive independent materials. Components 1 and 2 are displaced duplicate plastic parts. No part is uniformly rescaled. +Y is the button end; Grove points -Y; +Z is the weighing platform.
